execution_notes: The confirmation ran once (confirm.py --confirm) and verify.py printed VERIFIED; no frozen file changed.
Every metadata grid cell had a response (grid_metadata_without_response = 0).

LLM recovery behaved as registered: one re-prompt that keeps valid picks, then random fill. Random fill covered 63 of 702 cells for llm_no_vc and 48 of 702 for llm_conv_vc. maestro_llm made 127 swaps (5 invalid and ignored).
Provider spend $0.321 over 214 calls, under the $3.00 ceiling.
post_hoc_observations: Labelled exploratory: none of these was registered, and none changes a verdict.
Activity base rate on the confirmation library was 23% of cells (1,105 of 4,808), against about 7% on the phase-1 development tier.

Certified P(active) was calibrated where a compound had a profiled line (regime A1: mean 0.224 against an observed rate of 0.23). It was under-predicted and weakly ranked with no profiled line (regime B: mean 0.132 against 0.23; AUROC 0.64). That is the state every compound starts a campaign in.
At W = N, sparse_hub beat maestro in all 11 campaigns (-0.044). At 2N, maestro beat sparse_hub in 10 of 11 (+0.053, secondary).
